{{Quote|Honored hunter, you have bested the worst that the Rryatt Trail can send against you. You are a true warrior and an unparalleled hunter. All of Kashyyyk honors your accomplishments.|translated=1|Krepauk grants the knuckles of the katarn to a spacer|<ref name="Rage" />}}
The '''knuckles of the katarn''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] made from the [[Claw/Legends|claws]] of a [[Katarn/Legends|katarn]], a savage predator from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Custom-made by [[Krepauk]]&mdash;the [[Huntmaster]] of the [[Rryatt Trail]] on Kashyyyk&mdash;the knuckles of the katarn was once given to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who had [[Death/Legends|killed]] a katarn during a [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Description==
The knuckles of the [[Katarn/Legends|katarn]] was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] fashioned out of the [[Claw/Legends|claws]] of a katarn, one of the [[Death/Legends|deadliest]] predators on the Wookiee [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The weapon's handle had a claw at each end, while four additional claws extended from the forward end. The knuckles of the katarn had a range of four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and could be wielded with just one [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="Rage" />

==History==
The knuckles of the katarn was a custom-made weapon built by the Wookiee [[Krepauk]], the [[Huntmaster]] of the [[Rryatt Trail]] on Kashyyyk during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As Huntmaster, it was Krepauk's job to test the [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] skills and honor of the travelers of the trail by giving them a series of hunts. If the travelers proved themselves to be worthy, Krepauk would reward them with different items.<ref name="Rage" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Krepauk tasked a passing [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with several hunts that the spacer managed to complete, including killing a katarn in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]]. Impressed by the hunter's prowess, Krepauk gave the spacer a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a pair of hunting mounts. Krepauk also crafted the knuckles of the katarn for the spacer from the remains of the same katarn that the spacer had slain.<ref name="Rage" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The knuckles of the katarn appeared in the [[2005]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] from [[LucasArts]] and [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. In the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the player could receive the knuckles of the katarn for completing Krepauk's series of quests, known as the "Rryatt Trail Trials." Although the player could choose not to complete Krepauk's quests, this article assumes 100 percent game completion. The weapon dealt additional "cold" damage when used.<ref name="Rage" />
